typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Enclosure as string,
		Contact as string,
		Employer as string,
		{Contact Type} as string,
		{Access Granted} as timestamp,
		{Last Accessed} as timestamp,
		{Days of Inactivity} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		ContactType as string,
		AccessGranted as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Employer as string,
		LastAccessed as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DaysOfInactivity as double,
		Enclosure as string,
		FName as string,
		Contact as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		ContactType = {Contact Type},
		AccessGranted = {Access Granted},
		Employer,
		LastAccessed = {Last Accessed},
		DaysOfInactivity = {Days of Inactivity},
		Enclosure,
		FName,
		Contact),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
